parameters.content:
## Track Coupang product-option prices

### How it works
Run this workflow manually for one Coupang search keyword. It launches one charge-capped [FalconScrape Coupang Listings Scraper](https://apify.com/piotrv1001/coupang-listings-scraper) run, validates its dataset, and records KRW listing prices in Google Sheets. **Coupang Current** keeps the latest observed price per product-and-option ID; **Coupang History** keeps one observation per run and option; **Coupang Runs** stores run IDs for recovery. The first observation is a baseline. Later prices are compared only for the identical IDs and currency, never by similar product titles. A missing listing is not proof of a sell-out. The listed sales price may exclude shipping, coupons, or member-only conditions.

### Setup
1. Select an **Apify API** credential on the Apify HTTP nodes and **Google Sheets OAuth2** on the Sheets HTTP nodes. Create an empty spreadsheet and paste its ID into **Configure search**.
2. Enter one keyword. Keep the first test at 20 items and a $0.05 charge ceiling, then choose **Execute workflow**. The workflow creates its three tabs. The template is free; Actor runs and n8n hosting may cost money.
3. If execution stops, inspect **Coupang Runs** and Apify before retrying. After confirming no execution is active, remove a stale **_COUPANG_WORKFLOW_LOCK** tab and set **resumeRunId** to the saved run ID. Stopping n8n does not stop Apify.

### Customization
Keep one keyword per spreadsheet so history stays comparable. Archive to a fresh spreadsheet before reaching 5,000 rows in a tab. Scheduling is intentionally off until you review the first result and cost.

## 1. Set a small Korean product search
Enter one Coupang keyword and an empty spreadsheet ID. Start with 20 listings and a $0.05 Actor charge ceiling. Configuration and Sheets access are checked before starting paid work.

## 2. Create and protect three tabs
The workflow creates **Coupang Current**, **Coupang History**, and **Coupang Runs**. A temporary lock prevents overlapping writes. Existing headers and row capacity are checked before scraping.

nodes.name: 3. Start a new scrape or resume one

parameters.content:
## 3. Start or resume one scrape
Leave **resumeRunId** blank for a new capped run. Use a saved run ID to recover without launching another paid scrape. The original keyword and Actor settings must match this destination.

nodes.name: 4. Save the run ID and wait

parameters.content:
## 4. Save the run before waiting
The run ID is recorded in **Coupang Runs** before polling. Only a successful Actor result proceeds to import. If waiting stops, inspect Apify and resume that run rather than blindly starting another.

## 5. Compare the same product option
Only rows with a product ID, item ID, valid KRW sales price, and Coupang link are imported. Price changes compare the same product option, not similar titles. Ads and Rocket badges remain source flags.

## 6. Unlock and read the summary
Successful writes update current rows, append deduplicated observations, and close the run log. The lock is removed last. **Run summary** reports changed, baseline, rejected, and replayed counts with a spreadsheet link.
